module_summary: Glitch-free N-input clock mux: one-hot select gated by other clocks' disabled flags is glitch-filtered and synchronized per clock domain to drive clock gates, whose outputs are ORed and test-muxed.

anchors.name: async_sel_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous selection of which input clock propagates to clk_o.

anchors.name: clk_o
anchors.why: Glitch-free muxed output clock from test clock mux.

anchors.name: s_sel_onehot
anchors.why: One-hot decode of async_sel_i per input clock.

anchors.name: s_gate_enable_unfiltered_async
anchors.why: Per-clock request: selected and all other clocks disabled.

anchors.name: gen_input_stages[*].glitch_filter_q
anchors.why: Two-stage glitch filter register on the unfiltered enable.

anchors.name: s_glitch_filter_output_async
anchors.why: Filtered enable fed into the per-clock synchronizer.

anchors.name: s_gate_enable_sync
anchors.why: Synchronized enable from tc_sync in each clock domain.

anchors.name: s_gate_enable
anchors.why: Final clock gate enable, bypassed to unfiltered during reset.

anchors.name: async_reset_bypass_active_q
anchors.why: Selects reset bypass path for gate enable while reset active.

anchors.name: gen_input_stages[*].clock_has_been_disabled_q
anchors.why: Delayed disabled flag allowing other clocks to enable.

anchors.name: s_gated_clock
anchors.why: Per-input gated clocks combined by the OR tree.

anchors.name: s_output_clock
anchors.why: OR-tree output clock before test mux.

anchors.name: test_en_i
anchors.why: Test mode selects test_clk_i and bypasses reset sync.

groups.name: Select decode
groups.description: Decodes async select into one-hot per-clock requests.

groups.name: Per-clock enable stages
groups.description: Interlock, glitch filter, synchronizer and disabled flag per input clock.

groups.name: Clock gating and output
groups.description: Gates each clock, ORs gated clocks and muxes test clock.
